runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Marks the start of a conversational turn under session
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Preserve turnId so incremental text and terminal replies bind to the exact turn generation.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Indicates background business context has been hydrated into session memory
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Context is read-only positioning facts from Java, never grants permissions.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Optional plan disclosure when agent decomposes a complex query into multi-step execution
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: In pluggable runtime, models reason freely; plan disclosure is an informative progress hint.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Dispatched when an authorized business tool begins execution
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Emitted only after budget checks and deduplication passes.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Tool executed and produced factual result
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Output data feeds back into model reasoning loop for subsequent steps.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Tool failed or payload was clipped/truncated
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Clipped results must be distinctively marked as non-success so UI does not show false all-success.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Write tool requires explicit user confirmation via card before executing side-effects
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Must display conspicuous confirmation card; chat text cannot substitute for confirmation.
Must match active turnId; discarded if turn has failed or cancelled.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Whitelisted UI action (NAVIGATE, OPEN_MODAL, PREFILL_FORM, REFRESH_RESOURCE, FOCUS_ELEMENT)
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Executed by frontend action dispatcher; reports terminal receipt back via /agent-api.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Terminal success with final grounded reply and finish reason
Terminal error with stable error code and sanitized message
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Cleans up incomplete streaming text; sets status to failed.
Replaces partial streaming answer with explicit cancellation note.

finish_reasons.description: Natural model completion after fulfilling intent or tool operations
Explicit user cancellation via stop button or steer signal
Session or daily token/call budget limit reached (distinct from error)
Model generation hit maximum output token cap (must NOT be disguised as full completion)
Execution paused awaiting user approval on high-risk write action card
Unrecoverable runtime error, provider failure, or tool exception

error_codes.description: Requested action or tool is not permitted in current scope/audience
User daily or session budget exhausted
Execution or upstream connection timed out
Session is in invalid state or expired
Bearer token invalid, expired, or missing

requirements.title: Strict Monotonic Sequence Identification
requirements.specification: Every server-sent event must carry a monotonically increasing integer 'sequence' starting from 1 per conversation. Reconnecting client sends 'Last-Event-ID' with the last received sequence to replay missed events without duplicating side-effects.

requirements.title: Turn Generational Binding
requirements.specification: Every event belonging to a turn must carry 'turnId'. Content deltas from stale turns arriving late after a cancel or completed turn must be rejected by client using generational check.

requirements.title: Distinction Between Max Tokens and Completion
requirements.specification: The terminal event must provide a typed 'finishReason'. 'max_tokens' must never be conflated with 'completed' so frontend can inform user that output was truncated.

requirements.title: Clear Separation Between Tool Output and Model Response
requirements.specification: Tool execution events ('tool.call.*') must be sent as structured metadata cards distinct from 'content.delta'. Tool outputs must not leak into general chat streams unless summarized by model.

requirements.title: Ephemerality of Secrets and Clean Boundary
requirements.specification: The Runtime event stream must NEVER contain API keys, raw bearer tokens, database passwords, or local file system paths. Sanitized errors only.

requirements.title: Structured Interactivity Support (Questions & Steering)
requirements.specification: Runtime protocol must allow server to issue structured questions ('interaction.question') and allow client to respond ('interaction.response') or steer active run without terminating session.
